title: Loyalty Program

pointsPerVisit.description: Extra points awarded for each visit (0 to disable)

topEarners.title: Top Earners

card.title: Digital card
card.subtitle: This is the card your customers keep on their phone. It's yours: your logo, your colours.
card.info: Customers add this card to their phone's wallet. Every time you stamp a purchase the count goes up on its own — they never have to open an app.

brand.title: Your brand
brand.description: The logo shows at the top of the card; the icon shows in the phone's card list.
brand.noLogo: With no logo we use your business name
brand.noIcon: With no icon we use a square in your colour

colors.title: Colours
colors.description: Start from a theme and adjust whatever you like. Changes show instantly.
colors.label: Small text

stamps.title: The stamps
stamps.description: Pick the one that fits your business: a cup for coffee, scissors for a salon, a dumbbell for a gym.
stamps.countHint: Your card currently asks for {{count}} stamps. Change that on the Loyalty screen.
stamps.ownHint: A square PNG with a transparent background. Upload just one: the ones still missing are generated for you, fainter.

preview.title: Preview
preview.disclaimer: Approximation. This is how it looks on your customer's phone.

redeem.loadError: We couldn't check whether this customer has rewards to claim.

program.title: Your stamp program
program.description: How many purchases fill a card, and what the customer wins.
program.enabledHint: When off, customers still see their card but no stamps are earned.
program.requiredHint: Between 2 and 50. Each visit adds one stamp; a loyalty promotion can add more.
program.maxPerDay: Stamped visits per customer per day
program.maxPerDayHint: At least 1 per day. "No limit" stamps every visit.
program.rewardLabelHint: This is the text your customer sees on the card.
program.freeProductHint: The priciest item on the check is discounted, so the customer never pays a difference.
program.fixedAmountHint: How much is taken off the check.
program.percentageHint: What percentage is taken off the check (1 to 100).
program.maxPerDayRequired: Enter how many visits per day, or turn on "No limit".

poster.title: Counter poster
poster.description: Print it and stick it by the register. Customers scan it and sign themselves up.
poster.printBlocked: Your browser blocked the print window. Copy the link and open it separately.
poster.hint: Each person identifies with their own phone, so every customer gets THEIR card.
poster.headline: Collect stamps at {{venue}}
poster.subheadline: Scan with your phone camera and save your card.
poster.footnote: For now the card saves to iPhone. Ask us if you have Android.
poster.needsStamps: Turn on your stamp program above and the printable poster will appear here.

promotions.title: Loyalty promotions
promotions.subtitle: Give extra stamps or points on the dates you choose, like «double stamps» on Black Friday.
promotions.info: While a promotion is running, every sale with a customer gives them the promotion's stamps or points automatically. Nobody has to do anything at the register. This is not the same as combo and 2-for-1 promotions.

empty.title: You don't have loyalty promotions yet
empty.description: Create one to give double stamps or points on a weekend, a day of the week or a quiet hour.
empty.readOnly: When someone with permission creates one, it will show up here.

programOff.title: Turn on your loyalty program first
programOff.description: A promotion gives extra stamps or points, so your business needs to give stamps or points first.

promotions.cap: You already have 10 active or scheduled promotions. End one to create another.

confirmEnd.title: End «{{name}}» now?
confirmEnd.ACTIVE: It stops giving the bonus right now. What it already gave stays the same. You'll find it under Ended.
confirmEnd.SCHEDULED: It won't start. You'll find it under Ended.

dialog.activeNote: This promotion already started: you can only change its end date or end it. That way what it already gave never changes meaning.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.addHint: Extra stamps or points on each visit.
dialog.moreHint: Days and hours, products, minimum spend and how many times each customer earns it.
dialog.daysHint: If you pick none, it applies every day.
dialog.hoursHint: Leave it empty for all day.
dialog.minSpendHint: Minimum on the sale amount, not counting the tip. Leave it empty if there's no minimum.

errors.name: Give it a name (up to 80 characters).
errors.extra: Enter how many extra stamps or points it gives.
errors.startPast: It must start today or later.
errors.endDate: Choose when it ends or tick «No end».
errors.endBeforeStart: It must end on the day it starts or later.
errors.endPast: It must end today or later.
errors.hours: Enter both times, or leave both empty.
errors.minSpend: The minimum spend goes from $0 to $9,999,999.99, with up to 2 decimals.

preview.nothing: gives nothing extra with your current program
preview.limitONCE_PER_DAY: Each customer earns it once a day.
preview.limitONCE_PER_PROMOTION: Each customer earns it only once.
